Saying a sentence:
import pyttsx3
events = []
def began(**kw): events.append('started')
def ended(**kw): events.append('finished')
engine = pyttsx3.init()
engine.connect('started-utterance', began)
engine.connect('finished-utterance', ended)
queued = engine.say('Hello. How are you doing?')
print('say() returned', queued, '| events', len(events))
engine.runAndWait()
print('after runAndWait:', events)
init = 'import pyttsx3; e = pyttsx3.init(); '
once = init + 'e.runAndWait()'
twice = init + 'e.runAndWait(); e.runAndWait()'
print('once :', waits(once))
print('twice:', waits(twice))

Adding voice to Guess the Number:
import pyttsx3
engine = pyttsx3.init()
names = iter(['g1.wav', 'g2.wav', 'g3.wav', 'g4.wav'])
def speak(text):
    print(text)
    engine.save_to_file(text, next(names))
    engine.runAndWait()
def game(guesses, secret):
    speak('I am thinking of a number between 1 and 20.')
    for n, g in enumerate(guesses, 1):
        if g == secret: return speak('You won in %d.' % n)
        word = 'low' if g < secret else 'high'
        speak('%d is too %s.' % (g, word))
game([5, 18, 12], 12)
print([wavinfo('g%d.wav' % k)['seconds'] for k in range(1, 5)])
Singing 99 Bottles of Beer:
import pyttsx3
def bottles(k):
    if k == 0: return 'No more bottles'
    return '1 bottle' if k == 1 else '%d bottles' % k
def verse(n):
    this, nxt = bottles(n), bottles(n - 1)
    return (f'{this} of beer on the wall,\n{this} of beer,\n'
            'Take one down, pass it around,\n'
            f'{nxt} of beer on the wall.')
engine = pyttsx3.init()
for n in (3, 99):
    text = '\n\n'.join(verse(k) for k in range(n, 0, -1))
    name = 'song%d.wav' % n
    say_to(engine, text, name)
    print(n, 'verses:', wavinfo(name)['seconds'], 'seconds')

The YouTube Transcriber:
import glob, yt_dlp, whisper
def transcribe_urls(urls, formats=('srt',), model_name='tiny'):
    model = whisper.load_model(model_name)
    for k, url in enumerate(urls):
        stem = 'video%d' % k
        with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL(audio_opts(stem)) as ydl:
            ydl.download([url])
        audio = glob.glob(stem + '.*')[0]
        r = model.transcribe(audio, language='en', temperature=0)
        for f in formats: whisper.utils.get_writer(f, '.')(r, stem)
        print(len(r['segments']), 'segments')
URLS = ['https://archive.org/details/gettysburg_shurtagal_librivox',
        'https://archive.org/details/gettysburg_johng_librivox']
transcribe_urls(URLS, formats=('srt', 'vtt', 'txt'))
bad = ['https://archive.org/details/no_such_item_ch24_zz']
print('one bad address:', kind(transcribe_urls, bad))
